_comment: Optional pre-warming for the build cache.
The cache normally fills itself: anything a user builds is stored and
served instantly the next time someone asks for the same structure at the
same settings. You do not need this file.
It exists for the case where you want a specific structure warm before
anyone asks - a demo, a workshop, a link you are about to share. Add
python scripts/pregenerate.py --list     show the plan, build nothing
Be aware of the size. One large complex is 40-60 MB across its 3MF, GLB
and STL zip, so a long list adds up fast.
Fields: pdb_id, preset (a name from pdb2print/presets.py), and optional
overrides (PrintParams fields; 'connections' may be given as an object).
